name: Mechanical Plan-Lint then Adversarial Trio
description: Lint a plan mechanically FIRST - structure, missing sections, unnumbered steps, untestable acceptance, missing rollback - and only then spend three fresh adversarial reviewers on what a script cannot judge. The ordering IS the mechanism: if stage 0 fails hard the reviewers never run, because spending adversarial budget on a malformed plan is waste. All three lenses must PASS; a FAIL returns the plan to its author with the blocking items attached.

requirements_path.description: Requirements the plan must satisfy; when absent the completeness lens says NOT-CHECKED

constraints.description: Hard constraints the plan may not violate

cross_vendor_fourth_lens.description: Add a fourth cross-vendor reviewer on a high-stakes plan; three same-vendor lenses share blind spots

revisions_allowed.description: How many author revisions before the gate escalates instead of looping

linter.description: A deterministic script. It holds no discretion and its verdict is not an opinion.

feasibility_lens.description: Can this plan actually be executed with what exists today

completeness_lens.description: What the requirements demand and the plan omits

scope_lens.description: Steps that exceed the stated goal, and steps the goal needs that are absent

cross_vendor_lens.description: Optional fourth lens from another vendor for high-stakes plans

aggregator.description: Counts typed verdicts; it does not average opinions or break ties by vibe

routes.reason: three same-vendor lenses share blind spots on a high-stakes plan

stages.title: S0 LINT mechanically - structure, numbering, acceptance, rollback

work_unit.title: Run the deterministic plan lint before any reviewer is spent
work_unit.question_or_target: Check the plan for missing sections, unnumbered steps, untestable acceptance criteria and a missing rollback section.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: anything a script can decide is never sent to a model

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every violation names the section and the rule id; the lint records the exact command and exit code
tests_required: a plan with no rollback section MUST be caught by the LINT, not by a reviewer
the lint must be shown to fire on a known-bad plan before its silence counts as clean
a lint that found zero inputs must FAIL closed, since a lint over nothing is not a pass
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - a deterministic lint is asserted by tests, not reviewed
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN01-S0 only when the lint enumerated a non-empty input set and recorded its exit code; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN01-S0 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; a lint failure is a plan defect, not a flake

stages.title: S0 gate: a hard lint failure STOPS here - reviewers are not spent on a malformed plan
S1 FAN OUT three fresh adversarial lenses in parallel

work_unit.title: Review the plan through exactly one adversarial lens
work_unit.question_or_target: Return a typed PASS or FAIL for one lens, with each blocking item anchored to a numbered plan step.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: one lens per agent; a reviewer holding two lenses averages them

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each blocking item cites the plan step number and states what would have to be true for it to pass
tests_required: a structurally perfect but infeasible plan MUST be caught by a reviewer, not by the lint - the two benchmark cases must be caught by different stages
a reviewer returning untyped prose is retried ONCE with the verdict vocabulary enumerated inline, then counted as a null lens
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the aggregator, which counts lenses instead of averaging them
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN01-S1 only when the verdict token is recognised and every blocking item cites a plan step number; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN01-S1 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry with the vocabulary enumerated inline, then null lens

stages.title: S2 AGGREGATE typed verdicts and attribute each finding to its right stage

work_unit.title: Aggregate the typed verdicts and measure what the lint should have caught
work_unit.question_or_target: Count PASS and FAIL per lens, and flag every reviewer finding that a deterministic lint could have produced.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: counting typed verdicts is arithmetic; only the lint-attribution call is judgement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verdict records lenses_run and lenses_passed separately, so a null lens cannot be silently counted as a pass
tests_required: two PASS plus one null lens must NOT aggregate to a gate PASS
a reviewer finding that the lint rules already cover must be reported, so the lint can absorb it next time
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner reads the verdict; the gate does not need an opinion
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-PLN01-S2 only when lenses_run and lenses_passed are both recorded and a null lens is counted as neither; otherwise FAILED:BP3-PLN01-S2 <reason>

stages.title: S2 gate: all lenses that ran must have PASSED, and at least three must have run
S2b ADVISORY: findings a script could have made are lint debt, not review value

stopping_rules.expression: lint_hard_violations == 0 AND lenses_passed == lenses_run AND lenses_run >= 3

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the plan; writes only under command-center/plan-gate/**

x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: the ORDERING is the mechanism: a hard lint failure prevents the reviewers from running at all. BP-REQ-05 applies the same ordering to REQUIREMENTS; BP-CNC-01 reviews a DESIGN with personas and has no mechanical stage.
x_extensions.posture: SHADOW in its source form: advisory. Project governance may promote it to blocking, which is a stricter layer and therefore allowed.

worked_example.name: each benchmark case must be caught by the RIGHT stage
worked_example.narrative: Two plans. The first has no rollback section: the deterministic lint must catch it, and the reviewers must never be spent. The second is structurally perfect - numbered steps, rollback present, testable acceptance - but proposes a step that cannot be executed with what exists; the lint passes it and a reviewer must catch it. A blueprint where BOTH are caught by the same stage has lost the property.
worked_example.mechanism: mechanisms.is_testable (the lint's acceptance rule) + stage ordering

controls.mutate: give plan_a a rollback section and a testable criterion
controls.why: the lint must be able to pass, or it is a permanently-red gate that tells you nothing
